subject.title: [Feature]: UI 用量显示为 0，实际在消耗 token

question: Should OpenClaw add DashScope/Qwen account-usage support through the bundled qwen plugin, and what Alibaba endpoint/semantics should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior depends on maintainer acceptance of the provider contract and vendor proof for credential source, balance/quota payload shape, and whether the UI should show resettable windows or summary-only spend/credit text.

options.title: Define qwen usage hooks
options.body: Add provider-owned usage auth and snapshot hooks after confirming the DashScope endpoint, credential source, and quota/balance semantics.

options.title: Document unsupported account usage
options.body: Keep per-turn token accounting only, and document that Qwen/DashScope account usage is not shown until vendor proof is available.

options.title: Defer to a separate provider package
options.body: If maintainers do not want bundled Alibaba account-usage ownership, route the integration to an external qwen/Alibaba plugin path.

recommendation.title: Define qwen usage hooks
recommendation.body: Add provider-owned usage auth and snapshot hooks after confirming the DashScope endpoint, credential source, and quota/balance semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to provider-usage infrastructure, usage hooks, and the qwen provider boundary that would own the decision.
